steps.note: Open the eRFX create screen, which starts with the default Auction stage.
Give the create test a valid title without affecting stage composition.
Open the icon-only Add Stages menu to perform the first required move.
Verify Technical Stage is available from the default Auction stage.
Add the Technical Stage as the first composition move.
Confirm the project now contains Auction and Technical Stage.
Open the Auction stage overflow menu to delete Auction.
Choose Delete for the Auction stage.
Confirm deletion of the Auction stage.
Confirm only Technical Stage remains before adding RFQ.
Open Add Stages for the third required move.
Verify RFQ is available once Auction has been removed.
Add RFQ while Technical Stage is present.
Confirm the project now contains Technical Stage and RFQ.
Open the Technical Stage overflow menu to delete Technical Stage.
Choose Delete for the Technical Stage.
Confirm deletion of the Technical Stage.
Assert exactly one RFQ stage remains.
Explicitly select the remaining RFQ tab so its panel renders.
Verify the selected panel exposes RFQ create controls.
Verify the rendered panel is the RFQ panel.
